conbody.p: The alarm sounds and the hazard warning lights blink continuously for approximately 30 seconds if any of the following occur while the system is armed:

li.p: You open a front or rear door without using the smart key.
You open the tailgate without using the smart key.

conbody.p: Unless the system is disarmed, the horn will sound, the hazard warning lights blink continuously for approximately 30 seconds, and then the horn sounds 3 times. To turn the system OFF, unlock the doors with the remote key or smart key.
